sentences.en: I've had a perfectly wonderful evening. But this wasn't it.
sentences.zh: 我度过了一个美妙的夜晚。但这不是那个晚上。

sentences.en: Don't shout like that. I can hear you perfectly.
sentences.zh: 别那样喊。我听得一清二楚。

sentences.en: It's only a small house but it meets my needs perfectly.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个小小的房子，但它完全满足了我的需求。

senses.zh: 完美地;理想地完全地;十足地非常清楚；完全明白
